name.description: Name of the catalog. Must be provided as a map of language codes to translations.

description.description: Description of the catalog. Must be provided as a map of language codes to translations.

publishedSites.description: List of site identifiers on which the catalog is published.

categoryIds.description: List of root category identifiers that are assigned to the catalog.

Object.description: Localized field that must be provided as a map of language codes to translations.

version.description: Catalog version, if provided optimistic locking will be used.

visible.description: Flag indicating if the catalog is visible or not, set by the user.

from.description: Date and time from which the catalog is visible compliant with the ISO 8601 standard.

to.description: Data and time from which the catalog is visible compliant with the ISO 8601 standard.
